Lifecycle & I/O.name: load
Lifecycle & I/O.description: Loads an existing PowerPoint presentation from a file path (.pptx, .xml, .ppt), directory tree, remote URL, Buffer or stream. Inflates the PKZip container or Flat OPC XML, parses relationships, and mounts the in-memory Virtual File System (VFS).
Lifecycle & I/O.openXmlImpact: Reads ZIP archive entries: [Content_Types].xml, _rels/.rels, ppt/presentation.xml, ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels.
Lifecycle & I/O.edgeCases: Inspects ZIP magic bytes. Rejects malformed archives and XXE entity expansion attacks.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: File path, directory path, remote HTTP/HTTPS URL, raw binary buffer, readable stream.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Configuration options for parser, timeout, headers, and logger.

parameters.name: options.logLevel
parameters.description: Logging verbosity level during parsing and manipulations.

returns.description: Resolves to an initialized, chainable PPTXTemplater instance ready for templating operations.

Lifecycle & I/O.name: createBlank
Lifecycle & I/O.description: Creates a minimal, template-free blank PowerPoint presentation in memory from clean, valid OpenXML schemas with custom aspect ratio (16:9, 4:3, 16:10) or custom EMU/pixel dimensions. Contains 1 initial blank slide.
Lifecycle & I/O.openXmlImpact: Synthesizes minimal [Content_Types].xml, _rels/.rels, presentation.xml with specified dimensions, slideMaster1.xml, slideLayout1.xml, theme1.xml, and slide1.xml.
Lifecycle & I/O.edgeCases: Accepts '16:9', '4:3', '16:10' string aliases or explicit { width, height } in EMUs or pixels. Rejects invalid dimension inputs with PPTXError.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Creation options including aspect ratio, dimensions, and theme settings.

parameters.name: options.aspectRatio
parameters.description: Aspect ratio preset for slide canvas dimensions.

parameters.name: options.width
parameters.description: Custom slide width in EMUs (or pixels if options.unit is 'px').

parameters.name: options.height
parameters.description: Custom slide height in EMUs (or pixels if options.unit is 'px').

parameters.name: options.unit
parameters.description: Unit of measurement for custom dimensions.

returns.description: Resolves to an initialized PPTXTemplater instance with a single blank slide ready for adding content.

Lifecycle & I/O.name: extractPptx
Lifecycle & I/O.description: Unpacks a binary .pptx file into a folder of formatted OpenXML documents for automated inspection, security auditing, or batch transformation.
Lifecycle & I/O.openXmlImpact: Extracts and formats [Content_Types].xml, ppt/presentation.xml, slide XML, and relationships.
Lifecycle & I/O.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.

parameters.name: destinationFolder
parameters.description: Destination folder for unpacked OpenXML assets.

Lifecycle & I/O.name: buildPptx
Lifecycle & I/O.description: Compiles an extracted OpenXML directory back into a valid, zipped PowerPoint presentation file. Guarantees proper zip compression and relationship integrity.
Lifecycle & I/O.openXmlImpact: Scans directory, preserves binary media bytes, and zips back to compliant PresentationML package.
Lifecycle & I/O.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.

parameters.name: folderPath
parameters.description: Source folder containing extracted OpenXML files.

Lifecycle & I/O.name: preload
Lifecycle & I/O.description: Pre-reads, inflates, and caches a PPTX template into a high-speed memory cache. Subsequent calls to PPTXTemplater.fromCache() clone this pre-parsed memory state directly, eliminating disk reads and zip decompression overhead.
Lifecycle & I/O.openXmlImpact: Caches inflated OpenXML parts in memory; avoids repeating JSZip.loadAsync on heavy batch jobs.
Lifecycle & I/O.edgeCases: Inspects ZIP magic bytes. Rejects malformed archives and XXE entity expansion attacks.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Template file path or binary Buffer to inflate and cache.

returns.description: Resolves to the preloaded VirtualFileSystem representation stored in the global cache.

Lifecycle & I/O.name: fromCache
Lifecycle & I/O.description: Instantiates a new PPTXTemplater by deep-cloning an existing preloaded template cache. Delivers up to 10x higher throughput for concurrent report generation in high-concurrency API servers and cloud functions.
Lifecycle & I/O.openXmlImpact: Fast deep-copies the virtual OpenXML byte tree without reading from disk or re-parsing the zip container.
Lifecycle & I/O.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Cache key (file path string or Buffer identifier) previously passed to preload().

returns.description: Resolves to an isolated, ready-to-mutate PPTXTemplater instance.

Lifecycle & I/O.name: clearCache
Lifecycle & I/O.description: Clears all cached template packages from memory. Ideal for test teardown, memory reclamation, or when template files on disk have been hot-reloaded.
Lifecycle & I/O.openXmlImpact: Flushes global in-memory maps holding pre-inflated OpenXML byte arrays.
Lifecycle & I/O.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.

Lifecycle & I/O.name: saveToFile
Lifecycle & I/O.description: Serializes the entire in-memory PresentationML package, generates a standardized PKZip archive with DEFLATE compression, and writes the output file to disk. Creates any missing parent directories automatically.
Lifecycle & I/O.openXmlImpact: Recompresses all modified XML parts (ppt/slides/slide*.xml, [Content_Types].xml, etc.) into compliant binary PPTX container.
Lifecycle & I/O.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.

parameters.name: outputPath
parameters.description: Target destination file path where the generated .pptx will be saved.

parameters.name: options.compressionLevel
parameters.description: Zip compression level from 1 (fastest) to 9 (maximum compression).

returns.description: Resolves once the file stream has completely flushed and closed on disk.

Lifecycle & I/O.name: toBuffer
Lifecycle & I/O.description: Serializes the entire PowerPoint presentation into an in-memory Node.js binary Buffer. Essential for serverless architectures (AWS Lambda, Vercel Functions, Google Cloud Run) where local disk writes are prohibited or ephemeral.
Lifecycle & I/O.openXmlImpact: Compresses all OpenXML package parts directly into memory without touching the filesystem.
Lifecycle & I/O.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.

returns.description: Resolves to a binary Node.js Buffer containing the complete, valid .pptx file.

Lifecycle & I/O.name: toStream
Lifecycle & I/O.description: Returns a Node.js Readable stream emitting binary chunks of the compressed PPTX archive. Enables streaming responses with low memory footprints when producing massive decks.
Lifecycle & I/O.openXmlImpact: Streams zipped binary data directly from internal archive compression pipeline.
Lifecycle & I/O.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.

returns.description: Resolves to a Readable stream emitting binary chunks of the presentation.

Lifecycle & I/O.name: toBase64
Lifecycle & I/O.description: Serializes the presentation archive and returns it as a Base64 string or full Data URI string (data:application/vnd...;base64,...). Ideal for JSON API responses, client downloads, or webhook payloads.
Lifecycle & I/O.openXmlImpact: Converts in-memory zipped binary buffer into Base64 encoding.
Lifecycle & I/O.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.

parameters.name: options.dataUri
parameters.description: When true, prepends MIME type data URI scheme.

returns.description: Resolves to the base64-encoded presentation string.

Lifecycle & I/O.name: toArrayBuffer
Lifecycle & I/O.description: Serializes presentation into a raw in-memory ArrayBuffer, ideal for Cloudflare Workers, Vercel Edge, and Fetch API streaming.
Lifecycle & I/O.openXmlImpact: Flushes VirtualFileSystem into an uncompressed or compressed PKZip ArrayBuffer payload.
Lifecycle & I/O.edgeCases: Returns standard ArrayBuffer compatible with Web Streams and Edge Response objects.

returns.description: Resolves to binary ArrayBuffer representing the PPTX archive.

Lifecycle & I/O.exampleCode:
const arrayBuffer = await ppt.toArrayBuffer();
return new Response(arrayBuffer, { headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation' } });

Lifecycle & I/O.name: toResponse
Lifecycle & I/O.description: Compiles the presentation and returns a web-standard Web API Response object with binary ArrayBuffer body, correct OpenXML Content-Type headers, and optional Content-Disposition attachment header. Ideal for Next.js Route Handlers, Remix, SvelteKit, and Edge workers.
Lifecycle & I/O.openXmlImpact: Serializes VirtualFileSystem into PKZip binary buffer wrapped in standard Response.
Lifecycle & I/O.edgeCases: Encodes Unicode filenames safely into RFC-5987 Content-Disposition header.

returns.description: Resolves to a standard Web API Response object.

Lifecycle & I/O.name: toExpress
Lifecycle & I/O.description: Streams the presentation directly to an Express.js response object. Automatically sets the correct OpenXML MIME type (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation), Content-Disposition attachment header with encoded filename, and Content-Length.
Lifecycle & I/O.openXmlImpact: Direct HTTP response serialization with standardized OpenXML MIME headers.
Lifecycle & I/O.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: Filename suggested to the user client browser for download.

returns.description: Resolves when the response transmission completes.

Lifecycle & I/O.name: toFastify
Lifecycle & I/O.description: Pipes the presentation binary Buffer directly to a Fastify reply instance with correct OpenXML MIME type, Content-Length, and Content-Disposition download headers.
Lifecycle & I/O.openXmlImpact: Serializes in-memory presentation into binary buffer dispatched through Fastify reply pipeline.

returns.description: Resolves to the Fastify reply once transmitted.

Lifecycle & I/O.name: extractToZip
Lifecycle & I/O.description: Packages the in-memory presentation and writes a raw compressed PKZip archive file to disk. Ensures all directories exist before writing.
Lifecycle & I/O.openXmlImpact: Serializes entire VirtualFileSystem into compressed ZIP container written to destinationPath.

parameters.name: destinationPath
parameters.description: Target file path for the output ZIP archive.

returns.description: Resolves once archive file is written to disk.

Lifecycle & I/O.name: extractToXml
Lifecycle & I/O.description: Unpacks all OpenXML presentation parts (slides, charts, relationships, content types, themes) into an uncompressed folder on disk. Supports formatting and pretty-printing XML files for version control inspection.
Lifecycle & I/O.openXmlImpact: Writes individual files into directory structure mirroring the OpenXML package ([Content_Types].xml, _rels/, ppt/slides/, etc.).
Lifecycle & I/O.edgeCases: Preserves binary media files as raw buffers while optionally formatting XML documents with indentation.

parameters.name: destinationDir
parameters.description: Target folder path on disk where parts will be unpacked.

parameters.name: options.formatXml
parameters.description: When true, pretty-prints XML files with 2-space indentation for readable diffs and code review.

returns.description: Resolves once all presentation files have been written to the destination directory.

Lifecycle & I/O.name: toFlatXml
Lifecycle & I/O.description: Serializes the entire in-memory presentation into a Microsoft Flat OPC XML string (<pkg:package>). If a file path string is provided, writes directly to local disk and returns the XML string. If options are provided or omitted, returns the XML string directly in memory.
Lifecycle & I/O.openXmlImpact: Constructs a valid ISO/IEC 29500-2 Flat OPC XML document from the current VirtualFileSystem state without disk or ZIP overhead.
Lifecycle & I/O.edgeCases: Infers OpenXML MIME types for all parts and strips root [Content_Types].xml which is not part of Flat OPC schema.

parameters.name: destinationPathOrOptions
parameters.description: Destination file path string to save the XML file on disk, or formatting options object.

returns.description: Resolves to the serialized Flat OPC XML string.

Slides.name: useSlide
Slides.description: Directs subsequent slide-level operations (replacements, shape mutations, table updates, chart refreshes) to a specific 1-based slide index.
Slides.edgeCases: Throws error if 1-based slide index is out of bounds [1, slideCount]. Automatically resolves layout and relationship mappings.

Slides.name: useAllSlides
Slides.description: Switches the operation scope to target every slide currently present in the presentation deck. Operations like replaceText will execute across all slides.
Slides.openXmlImpact: Iterates through all  elements listed in ppt/presentation.xml .
Slides.edgeCases: Throws error if 1-based slide index is out of bounds [1, slideCount]. Automatically resolves layout and relationship mappings.

Slides.name: addSlide
Slides.description: Creates and appends a new blank slide to the end of the presentation. Automatically assigns a new relationship ID, links the slide layout part, and updates [Content_Types].xml.
Slides.openXmlImpact: Generates ppt/slides/slide{N}.xml, ppt/slides/_rels/slide{N}.xml.rels, appends  in presentation.xml, and registers in [Content_Types].xml.
Slides.edgeCases: Throws error if 1-based slide index is out of bounds [1, slideCount]. Automatically resolves layout and relationship mappings.

parameters.name: options.layoutNumber
parameters.description: Target slide layout index to link as parent.

returns.description: Object containing 1-based slide index and assigned relationship ID.

Slides.name: insertSlide
Slides.description: Inserts a new slide at a specific 1-based position within the presentation sequence, shifting subsequent slide entries accordingly.
Slides.openXmlImpact: Splices a new  into  in ppt/presentation.xml at the requested position.
Slides.edgeCases: Throws error if 1-based slide index is out of bounds [1, slideCount]. Automatically resolves layout and relationship mappings.

parameters.name: slideNumber
parameters.description: 1-based index where the new slide should be inserted.

Slides.name: duplicateSlide
Slides.description: Deep-clones an existing slide including all shapes, charts, tables, media, relationships, and layout bindings. Cloned parts receive newly generated unique relationship IDs to guarantee non-corrupted PresentationML structures.
Slides.openXmlImpact: Clones ppt/slides/slide{N}.xml, duplicates slide{N}.xml.rels, deep-copies linked charts/drawings, updates [Content_Types].xml and presentation.xml.
Slides.edgeCases: Throws error if 1-based slide index is out of bounds [1, slideCount]. Automatically resolves layout and relationship mappings.

parameters.name: insertAfterIndex
parameters.description: 1-based slide index after which the duplicate will be placed.

returns.description: Metadata with newly created slide index.

Slides.name: removeSlide
Slides.description: Removes a slide from the presentation by 1-based index. Deletes the corresponding  in presentation.xml, removes the relationship in presentation.xml.rels, and cleans up orphaned slide XML and relationship parts.
Slides.openXmlImpact: Deletes , unlinks relationship in presentation.xml.rels, removes slide{N}.xml and slide{N}.xml.rels.
Slides.edgeCases: Throws error if 1-based slide index is out of bounds [1, slideCount]. Automatically resolves layout and relationship mappings.
Slides.exampleCode:
// Remove temporary instruction slide
await ppt.removeSlide(1);

Slides.name: getSlides
Slides.description: Returns metadata for all slides currently configured in the presentation deck in their visual presentation order.
Slides.openXmlImpact: Reads  in ppt/presentation.xml and resolves target slide part names.
Slides.edgeCases: Throws error if 1-based slide index is out of bounds [1, slideCount]. Automatically resolves layout and relationship mappings.

returns.description: Array of slide descriptors with 1-based slideNumber, rId, and partName.

Slides.exampleCode:
const slides = ppt.getSlides();
console.log(`Presentation has ${slides.length} slides:`, slides);

Slides.name: getSlideDimensions
Slides.description: Inspects and returns the physical slide dimensions and aspect ratio configured for the presentation in inches, points, pixels, and EMUs.
Slides.edgeCases: Throws error if 1-based slide index is out of bounds [1, slideCount]. Automatically resolves layout and relationship mappings.

returns.description: Dimensions object with width, height, widthEmu, heightEmu, and aspect ratio type (e.g. "screen16x9").

Slides.exampleCode:
const dims = ppt.getSlideDimensions();
console.log(`Slide width: ${dims.width}in, height: ${dims.height}in (type: ${dims.type})`);

Slides.name: getSlideLayout
Slides.description: Resolves and returns the layout metadata associated with a targeted slide, including layout name, type, and parent slide master reference.
Slides.openXmlImpact: Follows relationship in slide{N}.xml.rels to ppt/slideLayouts/slideLayout{M}.xml.
Slides.edgeCases: Throws error if 1-based slide index is out of bounds [1, slideCount]. Automatically resolves layout and relationship mappings.
Slides.exampleCode:
const layout = ppt.getSlideLayout(1);
console.log(`Slide 1 uses layout: ${layout.name} (master: ${layout.master})`);

Slides.name: importSlideFrom
Slides.description: Imports a complete slide from another independent PPTXTemplater instance. Resolves, clones, and deep-remaps all dependencies (slide layouts, media files, embedded charts, hyperlinks) into the target deck while preventing relationship collisions.
Slides.openXmlImpact: Transfers external slide XML, re-indexes relationships in slide{N}.xml.rels, syncs [Content_Types].xml, and transfers media parts.
Slides.edgeCases: Throws error if 1-based slide index is out of bounds [1, slideCount]. Automatically resolves layout and relationship mappings.

parameters.name: sourceSlideNumber
parameters.description: 1-based slide index in source presentation to import.

returns.description: Imported slide descriptor with new slideIndex and rId.

Slides.name: exportSlides
Slides.description: Extracts a subset of slides from the current deck and returns a new, fully self-contained PPTXTemplater instance containing only those slides, preserving all required masters, themes, and media.
Slides.openXmlImpact: Constructs a new PresentationML package containing selected slides and pruned masters/layouts.
Slides.edgeCases: Throws error if 1-based slide index is out of bounds [1, slideCount]. Automatically resolves layout and relationship mappings.

parameters.name: slideNumbers
parameters.description: One or more 1-based slide indices to export.

returns.description: New independent PPTXTemplater instance containing extracted slides.

Slides.name: deleteSlide
Slides.description: Removes a slide from the presentation by 1-based index and purges its relationships and layout mappings from internal manifests.
Slides.openXmlImpact: Purges slide ID from ppt/presentation.xml and cleans ppt/slides/slideN.xml and .rels.
Slides.edgeCases: Throws error if slideIndex is invalid. Adjusts total slideCount and shifts subsequent slide references.

Text & Placeholders.name: replaceText
Text & Placeholders.description: Replaces template placeholders across targeted slides. Analyzes DrawingML AST paragraphs (<a:p>) and unifies fragmented text runs (<a:r> / <a:t>) split across spellchecks or editing sessions before substituting values.
Text & Placeholders.openXmlImpact: Parses <a:p> and <a:r>, joins adjacent <a:t> text nodes, preserves original <a:rPr> formatting, and updates slide XML.
Text & Placeholders.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.

Text & Placeholders.name: replaceMultiple
Text & Placeholders.description: Batch-replaces multiple placeholders across all targeted slides in a single optimized pass. Automatically wraps raw keys in {{...}} if delimiters are omitted.
Text & Placeholders.openXmlImpact: Traverses slide AST, normalizes placeholder tokens, and mutates <a:t> elements.
Text & Placeholders.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.

parameters.name: replacements
parameters.description: Map of keys to replacement strings or numbers.

Text & Placeholders.name: replaceTextByTag
Text & Placeholders.description: Replaces a single placeholder tag across targeted slides while rigorously preserving original run formatting properties (font typeface, size, color, bold, italics).
Text & Placeholders.openXmlImpact: Modifies targeted <a:t> run nodes under <a:p> without altering adjacent <a:rPr> tags.
Text & Placeholders.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.

Text & Placeholders.name: updateText
Text & Placeholders.description: Updates text content or synthesizes hierarchical bullet/numbered lists inside a shape or text frame by shape name, shape ID, or placeholder tag.
Text & Placeholders.openXmlImpact: Replaces paragraph text or synthesizes <a:pPr> bullet properties (<a:buChar>, <a:buAutoNum>, @_lvl, @_marL).
Text & Placeholders.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Shape name, shape ID, or placeholder tag.

parameters.name: valueOrListConfig
parameters.description: Plain text string or structured list configuration object.

Text & Placeholders.name: findText
Text & Placeholders.description: Searches for text occurrences across targeted slides. Scans all shapes, text boxes, and tables, returning match locations with slide index and shape identifiers.
Text & Placeholders.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.

returns.description: List of matches with slide numbers and shape names.

Text & Placeholders.exampleCode:
const matches = ppt.findText('ARR');
matches.forEach(m => console.log(`Found "${m.text}" on slide ${m.slideIndex} in shape "${m.shapeName}"`));

Text & Placeholders.name: appendTextRun
Text & Placeholders.description: Appends a new styled text run (<a:r>) to the end of the text frame of an existing shape. Supports custom font family, size, solid fill color, bold, italics, underline, and strike.
Text & Placeholders.openXmlImpact: Appends <a:r> with <a:rPr> (@_sz, @_b, <a:solidFill>) to the last <a:p> in <p:txBody>.
Text & Placeholders.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.

Text & Placeholders.name: prependTextRun
Text & Placeholders.description: Inserts a new styled text run at the very beginning of a shape's text frame, before all existing paragraphs and runs.
Text & Placeholders.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.

Text & Placeholders.name: extractPlaceholders
Text & Placeholders.description: Scans all text runs across targeted slides and extracts a unique list of all placeholder tokens matching the pattern (defaults to /\{\{([^\{\}]+)\}\}/g). Useful for validating payload completeness before template rendering.
Text & Placeholders.openXmlImpact: Parses all <a:t> elements across active slide XML parts.
Text & Placeholders.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.

parameters.name: pattern
parameters.description: Custom regular expression for placeholder detection.

returns.description: Array of unique placeholder tokens found.

Text & Placeholders.name: getList
Text & Placeholders.description: Extracts existing bulleted and numbered items from a shape or text box, returning each line with its hierarchical indentation level.
Text & Placeholders.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Shape name, shape ID, or placeholder tag.

returns.description: Array of items with text and 0-based indentation level.

Text & Placeholders.name: validateList
Text & Placeholders.description: Validates a structured list configuration before injecting it into slide XML. Checks list depth, text integrity, and bullet formatting parameters.
Text & Placeholders.openXmlImpact: Schema verification utility for DrawingML paragraph properties.
Text & Placeholders.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.

parameters.name: listConfig
parameters.description: List configuration object with list array and optional style.

Text & Placeholders.exampleCode:
const result = PPTXTemplater.validateList({ list: ['Item 1', 'Item 2'] });
if (!result.valid) console.error('List errors:', result.errors);

Tables & Cell Shapes.name: addTable
Tables & Cell Shapes.description: Creates a brand-new table on the active slide. Generates DrawingML table structure (<a:tbl>) with customizable row count, column count, column widths, coordinates, styles, and initial data matrix.
Tables & Cell Shapes.edgeCases: Validates row/column indices and handles merged cell boundaries without XML element interleaving.

parameters.name: tableIdOrOptions
parameters.description: Table identifier name or full configuration options.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Table configuration (rows, cols, x, y, width, height, data).

returns.description: Resolves to the newly created table shape ID.

Tables & Cell Shapes.name: updateTable
Tables & Cell Shapes.description: Replaces table cell values with a 2D array matrix of strings or numbers. Matches existing rows and columns while preserving all existing cell formatting (background fills, fonts, borders, alignments).
Tables & Cell Shapes.openXmlImpact: Iterates existing <a:tr> and <a:tc> elements, updating text run values in <a:t>.
Tables & Cell Shapes.edgeCases: Validates row/column indices and handles merged cell boundaries without XML element interleaving.

Tables & Cell Shapes.name: getTableRows
Tables & Cell Shapes.description: Extracts data from an existing table on the active slide. Can return rows as structured JSON objects (using header row values as object keys) or as raw 2D string matrices.
Tables & Cell Shapes.openXmlImpact: Parses <a:tbl> cells and extracts text from <a:t> elements.
Tables & Cell Shapes.edgeCases: Validates row/column indices and handles merged cell boundaries without XML element interleaving.

parameters.name: options.asObjects
parameters.description: When true, formats rows as JSON objects using table headers.

returns.description: Array of extracted table row records.

Tables & Cell Shapes.name: addTableRow
Tables & Cell Shapes.description: Appends a new row to an existing table. Supports nested arrays for multi-row merging (rowspan), automatic cell styling, custom background fills, and borders.
Tables & Cell Shapes.openXmlImpact: Synthesizes and appends <a:tr> containing <a:tc> cells into <a:tbl>.
Tables & Cell Shapes.edgeCases: Validates row/column indices and handles merged cell boundaries without XML element interleaving.

parameters.name: rowData
parameters.description: Array of cell values for the new row.

Tables & Cell Shapes.name: mergeCells
Tables & Cell Shapes.description: Merges a rectangular block of cells across rows and/or columns. Applies compliant OpenXML rowspan and colspan attributes (rowSpan, gridSpan, hMerge, vMerge) without corrupting PowerPoint.
Tables & Cell Shapes.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.
Tables & Cell Shapes.exampleCode:
// Merge header cells across columns 1 to 3
await ppt.useSlide(1).mergeCells('financials_table', 0, 1, 0, 3);

Tables & Cell Shapes.name: cloneMergedRegion
Tables & Cell Shapes.description: Replicates an existing merged cell topology across multiple contiguous rows or columns.
Tables & Cell Shapes.openXmlImpact: Copies <a:tcPr> merge flags across corresponding row indices in <a:tbl>.
Tables & Cell Shapes.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.

Tables & Cell Shapes.name: autoFitTable
Tables & Cell Shapes.description: Automatically calculates and distributes column widths in <a:tblGrid> based on text length and typography metrics, preventing awkward text wrapping.
Tables & Cell Shapes.edgeCases: Validates row/column indices and handles merged cell boundaries without XML element interleaving.

Tables & Cell Shapes.name: splitTableOnOverflow
Tables & Cell Shapes.description: Automatically splits large tables across consecutive duplicate slides when table height exceeds a slide threshold. Preserves repeated headers across all generated slides and keeps summary/totals rows pinned to the final slide.
Tables & Cell Shapes.openXmlImpact: Calculates cumulative row heights in EMUs, duplicates slide XML, chunks <a:tr> rows, and syncs slide relationships.
Tables & Cell Shapes.edgeCases: Validates row/column indices and handles merged cell boundaries without XML element interleaving.

parameters.name: options.bottomMargin
parameters.description: Bottom margin threshold for triggering split.

parameters.name: options.repeatHeaders
parameters.description: Number of header rows to repeat on each split slide.

parameters.name: options.summaryRows
parameters.description: Number of summary rows to preserve on the final slide.

returns.description: Pagination outcome with splitCount and slidesCreated.

Tables & Cell Shapes.name: getCellBounds
Tables & Cell Shapes.description: Computes the exact absolute spatial bounding box (x, y, width, height) of a table cell in EMUs relative to the slide canvas. Critical for placing floating badge shapes or icons precisely inside cells.
Tables & Cell Shapes.openXmlImpact: Derives coordinates from table position (<a:xfrm>), <a:tblGrid> column widths, and row heights.
Tables & Cell Shapes.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.
Tables & Cell Shapes.exampleCode:
const bounds = ppt.useSlide(1).getCellBounds('status_table', 2, 3);
console.log(`Cell spatial coordinates:`, bounds);

Tables & Cell Shapes.name: addCellShape
Tables & Cell Shapes.description: Embeds a geometric badge or indicator shape (pill, status circle, checkmark) directly inside a table cell, positioned dynamically according to cell bounds.
Tables & Cell Shapes.openXmlImpact: Inserts a positioned <p:sp> into <p:spTree> aligned with cell spatial boundaries.
Tables & Cell Shapes.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.

Tables & Cell Shapes.name: updateCellShape
Tables & Cell Shapes.description: Updates properties (fill color, text label, border) of an indicator shape previously placed inside a table cell.
Tables & Cell Shapes.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads an existing PowerPoint presentation from a file path (.pptx, .pptm, .potx, .potm, .ppsx, .ppsm, .xml, .odp, .ppt), directory tree, remote URL, Buffer, stream, or cloud object store configuration. Inflates the PKZip container or Flat OPC XML, parses relationships, and mounts the in-memory Virtual File System (VFS).
methods.openXmlImpact: Reads ZIP archive entries: [Content_Types].xml, _rels/.rels, ppt/presentation.xml, ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels.
methods.edgeCases: Inspects ZIP magic bytes. Rejects malformed archives and XXE entity expansion attacks.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: File path, directory path, remote HTTP/HTTPS URL, raw binary buffer, readable stream, or cloud storage configuration ({ provider: 's3' | 'gcs' | 'azure', ... }).

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Configuration options for parser, timeout, headers, and logger.

parameters.name: options.logLevel
parameters.description: Logging verbosity level during parsing and manipulations.

returns.description: Resolves to an initialized, chainable PPTXTemplater instance ready for templating operations.

methods.name: preload
methods.description: Pre-reads, inflates, and caches a PPTX template into a high-speed memory cache. Subsequent calls to PPTXTemplater.fromCache() clone this pre-parsed memory state directly, eliminating disk reads and zip decompression overhead.
methods.openXmlImpact: Caches inflated OpenXML parts in memory; avoids repeating JSZip.loadAsync on heavy batch jobs.
methods.edgeCases: Inspects ZIP magic bytes. Rejects malformed archives and XXE entity expansion attacks.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Template file path or binary Buffer to inflate and cache.

returns.description: Resolves to the preloaded VirtualFileSystem representation stored in the global cache.

methods.name: fromCache
methods.description: Instantiates a new PPTXTemplater by deep-cloning an existing preloaded template cache. Delivers up to 10x higher throughput for concurrent report generation in high-concurrency API servers and cloud functions.
methods.openXmlImpact: Fast deep-copies the virtual OpenXML byte tree without reading from disk or re-parsing the zip container.
methods.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Cache key (file path string or Buffer identifier) previously passed to preload().

returns.description: Resolves to an isolated, ready-to-mutate PPTXTemplater instance.

methods.name: clearCache
methods.description: Clears all cached template packages from memory. Ideal for test teardown, memory reclamation, or when template files on disk have been hot-reloaded.
methods.openXmlImpact: Flushes global in-memory maps holding pre-inflated OpenXML byte arrays.
methods.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.

parameters.name: options.aspectRatio
parameters.description: Aspect ratio preset for slide canvas dimensions.

parameters.name: options.width
parameters.description: Custom slide width in EMUs (or pixels if options.unit is 'px').

parameters.name: options.height
parameters.description: Custom slide height in EMUs (or pixels if options.unit is 'px').

parameters.name: options.unit
parameters.description: Unit of measurement for custom dimensions.

returns.description: Resolves to an initialized PPTXTemplater instance with a single blank slide ready for adding content.

methods.name: toResponse
methods.description: Compiles the presentation and returns a web-standard Web API Response object with binary ArrayBuffer body, correct OpenXML Content-Type headers, and optional Content-Disposition attachment header. Ideal for Next.js Route Handlers, Remix, SvelteKit, and Edge workers.
methods.openXmlImpact: Serializes VirtualFileSystem into PKZip binary buffer wrapped in standard Response.
methods.edgeCases: Encodes Unicode filenames safely into RFC-5987 Content-Disposition header.

returns.description: Resolves to a standard Web API Response object.

methods.name: toFastify
methods.description: Pipes the presentation binary Buffer directly to a Fastify reply instance with correct OpenXML MIME type, Content-Length, and Content-Disposition download headers.
methods.openXmlImpact: Serializes in-memory presentation into binary buffer dispatched through Fastify reply pipeline.
methods.edgeCases: Handles Fastify header chaining (.type, .header, .send).

returns.description: Resolves to the Fastify reply once transmitted.

methods.name: extractToZip
methods.description: Packages the in-memory presentation and writes a raw compressed PKZip archive file to disk. Ensures all directories exist before writing.
methods.openXmlImpact: Serializes entire VirtualFileSystem into compressed ZIP container written to destinationPath.
methods.edgeCases: Creates nested parent directories recursively.

parameters.name: destinationPath
parameters.description: Target file path for the output ZIP archive.

returns.description: Resolves once archive file is written to disk.

methods.exampleCode:
const ppt = await PPTXTemplater.load('./presentation.pptx');
await ppt.extractToZip('./backups/presentation-raw.zip');

methods.name: extractToXml
methods.description: Unpacks all OpenXML presentation parts (slides, charts, relationships, content types, themes) into an uncompressed folder on disk. Supports formatting and pretty-printing XML files for version control inspection.
methods.openXmlImpact: Writes individual files into directory structure mirroring the OpenXML package ([Content_Types].xml, _rels/, ppt/slides/, etc.).
methods.edgeCases: Preserves binary media files as raw buffers while optionally formatting XML documents with indentation.

parameters.name: destinationDir
parameters.description: Target folder path on disk where parts will be unpacked.

parameters.name: options.formatXml
parameters.description: When true, pretty-prints XML files with 2-space indentation for readable diffs and code review.

returns.description: Resolves once all presentation files have been written to the destination directory.

methods.name: toFlatXml
methods.description: Serializes the entire in-memory presentation into a Microsoft Flat OPC XML string (<pkg:package>). If a file path string is provided, writes directly to local disk and returns the XML string. If options are provided or omitted, returns the XML string directly in memory.
methods.openXmlImpact: Constructs a valid ISO/IEC 29500-2 Flat OPC XML document from the current VirtualFileSystem state without disk or ZIP overhead.
methods.edgeCases: Infers OpenXML MIME types for all parts and strips root [Content_Types].xml which is not part of Flat OPC schema.

parameters.name: destinationPathOrOptions
parameters.description: Destination file path string to save the XML file on disk, or formatting options object.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Optional Flat OPC serialization options (pretty, excludeBinaryParts) when the first parameter is a destination path string.

returns.description: Resolves to the serialized Flat OPC XML string.

methods.name: useSlide
methods.description: Directs subsequent slide-level operations (replacements, shape mutations, table updates, chart refreshes) to a specific 1-based slide index.
methods.openXmlImpact: Sets internal pointer targeting ppt/slides/slide{N}.xml.
methods.edgeCases: Throws error if 1-based slide index is out of bounds [1, slideCount]. Automatically resolves layout and relationship mappings.
methods.exampleCode:
ppt.useSlide(2)
   .replaceText({ '{{agenda}}': 'Financial Overview' });

methods.name: useAllSlides
methods.description: Switches the operation scope to target every slide currently present in the presentation deck. Operations like replaceText will execute across all slides.
methods.openXmlImpact: Iterates through all  elements listed in ppt/presentation.xml .
methods.edgeCases: Throws error if 1-based slide index is out of bounds [1, slideCount]. Automatically resolves layout and relationship mappings.

methods.name: addSlide
methods.description: Creates and appends a new blank slide to the end of the presentation. Automatically assigns a new relationship ID, links the slide layout part, and updates [Content_Types].xml.
methods.openXmlImpact: Generates ppt/slides/slide{N}.xml, ppt/slides/_rels/slide{N}.xml.rels, appends  in presentation.xml, and registers in [Content_Types].xml.
methods.edgeCases: Throws error if 1-based slide index is out of bounds [1, slideCount]. Automatically resolves layout and relationship mappings.

parameters.name: options.layoutNumber
parameters.description: Target slide layout index to link as parent.

returns.description: Object containing 1-based slide index and assigned relationship ID.

methods.name: insertSlide
methods.description: Inserts a new slide at a specific 1-based position within the presentation sequence, shifting subsequent slide entries accordingly.
methods.openXmlImpact: Splices a new  into  in ppt/presentation.xml at the requested position.
methods.edgeCases: Throws error if 1-based slide index is out of bounds [1, slideCount]. Automatically resolves layout and relationship mappings.

parameters.name: slideNumber
parameters.description: 1-based index where the new slide should be inserted.

methods.name: duplicateSlide
methods.description: Deep-clones an existing slide including all shapes, charts, tables, media, relationships, and layout bindings. Cloned parts receive newly generated unique relationship IDs to guarantee non-corrupted PresentationML structures.
methods.openXmlImpact: Clones ppt/slides/slide{N}.xml, duplicates slide{N}.xml.rels, deep-copies linked charts/drawings, updates [Content_Types].xml and presentation.xml.
methods.edgeCases: Throws error if 1-based slide index is out of bounds [1, slideCount]. Automatically resolves layout and relationship mappings.

parameters.name: insertAfterIndex
parameters.description: 1-based slide index after which the duplicate will be placed.

returns.description: Metadata with newly created slide index.

methods.name: removeSlide
methods.description: Removes a slide from the presentation by 1-based index. Deletes the corresponding  in presentation.xml, removes the relationship in presentation.xml.rels, and cleans up orphaned slide XML and relationship parts.
methods.openXmlImpact: Deletes , unlinks relationship in presentation.xml.rels, removes slide{N}.xml and slide{N}.xml.rels.
methods.edgeCases: Throws error if 1-based slide index is out of bounds [1, slideCount]. Automatically resolves layout and relationship mappings.
methods.exampleCode:
// Remove temporary instruction slide
await ppt.removeSlide(1);

methods.name: getSlides
methods.description: Returns metadata for all slides currently configured in the presentation deck in their visual presentation order.
methods.openXmlImpact: Reads  in ppt/presentation.xml and resolves target slide part names.
methods.edgeCases: Throws error if 1-based slide index is out of bounds [1, slideCount]. Automatically resolves layout and relationship mappings.

returns.description: Array of slide descriptors with 1-based slideNumber, rId, and partName.

methods.exampleCode:
const slides = ppt.getSlides();
console.log(`Presentation has ${slides.length} slides:`, slides);

methods.name: getSlideDimensions
methods.description: Inspects and returns the physical slide dimensions and aspect ratio configured for the presentation in inches, points, pixels, and EMUs.
methods.openXmlImpact: Parses  in ppt/presentation.xml.
methods.edgeCases: Throws error if 1-based slide index is out of bounds [1, slideCount]. Automatically resolves layout and relationship mappings.

returns.description: Dimensions object with width, height, widthEmu, heightEmu, and aspect ratio type (e.g. "screen16x9").

methods.exampleCode:
const dims = ppt.getSlideDimensions();
console.log(`Slide width: ${dims.width}in, height: ${dims.height}in (type: ${dims.type})`);

methods.name: getSlideLayout
methods.description: Resolves and returns the layout metadata associated with a targeted slide, including layout name, type, and parent slide master reference.
methods.openXmlImpact: Follows relationship in slide{N}.xml.rels to ppt/slideLayouts/slideLayout{M}.xml.
methods.edgeCases: Throws error if 1-based slide index is out of bounds [1, slideCount]. Automatically resolves layout and relationship mappings.
methods.exampleCode:
const layout = ppt.getSlideLayout(1);
console.log(`Slide 1 uses layout: ${layout.name} (master: ${layout.master})`);

methods.name: importSlideFrom
methods.description: Imports a complete slide from another independent PPTXTemplater instance. Resolves, clones, and deep-remaps all dependencies (slide layouts, media files, embedded charts, hyperlinks) into the target deck while preventing relationship collisions.
methods.openXmlImpact: Transfers external slide XML, re-indexes relationships in slide{N}.xml.rels, syncs [Content_Types].xml, and transfers media parts.
methods.edgeCases: Throws error if 1-based slide index is out of bounds [1, slideCount]. Automatically resolves layout and relationship mappings.

parameters.name: sourceSlideNumber
parameters.description: 1-based slide index in source presentation to import.

returns.description: Imported slide descriptor with new slideIndex and rId.

methods.name: exportSlides
methods.description: Extracts a subset of slides from the current deck and returns a new, fully self-contained PPTXTemplater instance containing only those slides, preserving all required masters, themes, and media.
methods.openXmlImpact: Constructs a new PresentationML package containing selected slides and pruned masters/layouts.
methods.edgeCases: Throws error if 1-based slide index is out of bounds [1, slideCount]. Automatically resolves layout and relationship mappings.

parameters.name: slideNumbers
parameters.description: One or more 1-based slide indices to export.

returns.description: New independent PPTXTemplater instance containing extracted slides.

methods.name: deleteSlide
methods.description: Removes a slide from the presentation by 1-based index and purges its relationships and layout mappings from internal manifests.
methods.openXmlImpact: Purges slide ID from ppt/presentation.xml and cleans ppt/slides/slideN.xml and .rels.
methods.edgeCases: Throws error if slideIndex is invalid. Adjusts total slideCount and shifts subsequent slide references.
methods.exampleCode: ppt.deleteSlide(3); // Deletes the 3rd slide

methods.name: replaceText
methods.description: Replaces template placeholders across targeted slides. Analyzes DrawingML AST paragraphs (<a:p>) and unifies fragmented text runs (<a:r> / <a:t>) split across spellchecks or editing sessions before substituting values.
methods.openXmlImpact: Parses <a:p> and <a:r>, joins adjacent <a:t> text nodes, preserves original <a:rPr> formatting, and updates slide XML.
methods.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.

methods.name: replaceMultiple
methods.description: Batch-replaces multiple placeholders across all targeted slides in a single optimized pass. Automatically wraps raw keys in {{...}} if delimiters are omitted.
methods.openXmlImpact: Traverses slide AST, normalizes placeholder tokens, and mutates <a:t> elements.
methods.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.

parameters.name: replacements
parameters.description: Map of keys to replacement strings or numbers.

methods.name: replaceTextByTag
methods.description: Replaces a single placeholder tag across targeted slides while rigorously preserving original run formatting properties (font typeface, size, color, bold, italics).
methods.openXmlImpact: Modifies targeted <a:t> run nodes under <a:p> without altering adjacent <a:rPr> tags.
methods.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.
methods.exampleCode: ppt.useSlide(1).replaceTextByTag('revenue', '$142.5M');

methods.name: updateText
methods.description: Updates text content or synthesizes hierarchical bullet/numbered lists inside a shape or text frame by shape name, shape ID, or placeholder tag.
methods.openXmlImpact: Replaces paragraph text or synthesizes <a:pPr> bullet properties (<a:buChar>, <a:buAutoNum>, @_lvl, @_marL).
methods.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Shape name, shape ID, or placeholder tag.

parameters.name: valueOrListConfig
parameters.description: Plain text string or structured list configuration object.

methods.name: findText
methods.description: Searches for text occurrences across targeted slides. Scans all shapes, text boxes, and tables, returning match locations with slide index and shape identifiers.
methods.openXmlImpact: Recursively inspects <p:spTree>, <p:sp>, <p:graphicFrame>, and <a:t> nodes.
methods.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.

returns.description: List of matches with slide numbers and shape names.

methods.exampleCode:
const matches = ppt.findText('ARR');
matches.forEach(m => console.log(`Found "${m.text}" on slide ${m.slideIndex} in shape "${m.shapeName}"`));

methods.name: appendTextRun
methods.description: Appends a new styled text run (<a:r>) to the end of the text frame of an existing shape. Supports custom font family, size, solid fill color, bold, italics, underline, and strike.
methods.openXmlImpact: Appends <a:r> with <a:rPr> (@_sz, @_b, <a:solidFill>) to the last <a:p> in <p:txBody>.
methods.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.

methods.name: prependTextRun
methods.description: Inserts a new styled text run at the very beginning of a shape's text frame, before all existing paragraphs and runs.
methods.openXmlImpact: Prepends <a:r> to the first <a:p> under <p:txBody>.
methods.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.

methods.name: extractPlaceholders
methods.description: Scans all text runs across targeted slides and extracts a unique list of all placeholder tokens matching the pattern (defaults to /\{\{([^\{\}]+)\}\}/g). Useful for validating payload completeness before template rendering.
methods.openXmlImpact: Parses all <a:t> elements across active slide XML parts.
methods.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.

parameters.name: pattern
parameters.description: Custom regular expression for placeholder detection.

returns.description: Array of unique placeholder tokens found.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Extracts existing bulleted and numbered items from a shape or text box, returning each line with its hierarchical indentation level.
methods.openXmlImpact: Reads <a:p> elements and parses <a:pPr @_lvl="...">.
methods.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Shape name, shape ID, or placeholder tag.

returns.description: Array of items with text and 0-based indentation level.

methods.exampleCode:
const items = ppt.useSlide(2).getList('action_items');
items.forEach(item => console.log(`Level ${item.level}: ${item.text}`));

methods.name: validateList
methods.description: Validates a structured list configuration before injecting it into slide XML. Checks list depth, text integrity, and bullet formatting parameters.
methods.openXmlImpact: Schema verification utility for DrawingML paragraph properties.
methods.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.

parameters.name: listConfig
parameters.description: List configuration object with list array and optional style.

methods.exampleCode:
const result = PPTXTemplater.validateList({ list: ['Item 1', 'Item 2'] });
if (!result.valid) console.error('List errors:', result.errors);

methods.name: addTable
methods.description: Creates a brand-new table on the active slide. Generates DrawingML table structure (<a:tbl>) with customizable row count, column count, column widths, coordinates, styles, and initial data matrix.
methods.openXmlImpact: Appends <p:graphicFrame> containing <a:tbl>, <a:tblPr>, <a:tblGrid>, and <a:tr> rows.
methods.edgeCases: Validates row/column indices and handles merged cell boundaries without XML element interleaving.

parameters.name: tableIdOrOptions
parameters.description: Table identifier name or full configuration options.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Table configuration (rows, cols, x, y, width, height, data).

returns.description: Resolves to the newly created table shape ID.

methods.name: updateTable
methods.description: Replaces table cell values with a 2D array matrix of strings or numbers. Matches existing rows and columns while preserving all existing cell formatting (background fills, fonts, borders, alignments).
methods.openXmlImpact: Iterates existing <a:tr> and <a:tc> elements, updating text run values in <a:t>.
methods.edgeCases: Validates row/column indices and handles merged cell boundaries without XML element interleaving.

methods.name: getTableRows
methods.description: Extracts data from an existing table on the active slide. Can return rows as structured JSON objects (using header row values as object keys) or as raw 2D string matrices.
methods.openXmlImpact: Parses <a:tbl> cells and extracts text from <a:t> elements.
methods.edgeCases: Validates row/column indices and handles merged cell boundaries without XML element interleaving.

parameters.name: options.asObjects
parameters.description: When true, formats rows as JSON objects using table headers.

returns.description: Array of extracted table row records.

methods.name: addTableRow
methods.description: Appends a new row to an existing table. Supports nested arrays for multi-row merging (rowspan), automatic cell styling, custom background fills, and borders.
methods.openXmlImpact: Synthesizes and appends <a:tr> containing <a:tc> cells into <a:tbl>.
methods.edgeCases: Validates row/column indices and handles merged cell boundaries without XML element interleaving.

parameters.name: rowData
parameters.description: Array of cell values for the new row.

methods.name: mergeCells
methods.description: Merges a rectangular block of cells across rows and/or columns. Applies compliant OpenXML rowspan and colspan attributes (rowSpan, gridSpan, hMerge, vMerge) without corrupting PowerPoint.
methods.openXmlImpact: Sets @_rowSpan, @_gridSpan, @_vMerge="1", and @_hMerge="1" on <a:tcPr>.
methods.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.
methods.exampleCode:
// Merge header cells across columns 1 to 3
await ppt.useSlide(1).mergeCells('financials_table', 0, 1, 0, 3);

methods.name: cloneMergedRegion
methods.description: Replicates an existing merged cell topology across multiple contiguous rows or columns.
methods.openXmlImpact: Copies <a:tcPr> merge flags across corresponding row indices in <a:tbl>.
methods.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.

methods.name: autoFitTable
methods.description: Automatically calculates and distributes column widths in <a:tblGrid> based on text length and typography metrics, preventing awkward text wrapping.
methods.openXmlImpact: Recalculates <a:gridCol @_w="..."> values in <a:tblGrid>.
methods.edgeCases: Validates row/column indices and handles merged cell boundaries without XML element interleaving.
methods.exampleCode: await ppt.useSlide(1).autoFitTable('data_table', { minColWidth: '1.2in' });

methods.name: splitTableOnOverflow
methods.description: Automatically splits large tables across consecutive duplicate slides when table height exceeds a slide threshold. Preserves repeated headers across all generated slides and keeps summary/totals rows pinned to the final slide.

methods.edgeCases: Validates row/column indices and handles merged cell boundaries without XML element interleaving.

parameters.name: options.bottomMargin
parameters.description: Bottom margin threshold for triggering split.

parameters.name: options.repeatHeaders
parameters.description: Number of header rows to repeat on each split slide.

parameters.name: options.summaryRows
parameters.description: Number of summary rows to preserve on the final slide.

returns.description: Pagination outcome with splitCount and slidesCreated.

methods.name: getCellBounds
methods.description: Computes the exact absolute spatial bounding box (x, y, width, height) of a table cell in EMUs relative to the slide canvas. Critical for placing floating badge shapes or icons precisely inside cells.

methods.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.
methods.exampleCode:
const bounds = ppt.useSlide(1).getCellBounds('status_table', 2, 3);
console.log(`Cell spatial coordinates:`, bounds);

methods.name: addCellShape
methods.description: Embeds a geometric badge or indicator shape (pill, status circle, checkmark) directly inside a table cell, positioned dynamically according to cell bounds.
methods.openXmlImpact: Inserts a positioned <p:sp> into <p:spTree> aligned with cell spatial boundaries.
methods.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.

methods.name: updateCellShape
methods.description: Updates properties (fill color, text label, border) of an indicator shape previously placed inside a table cell.
methods.openXmlImpact: Modifies <p:sp> properties within <p:spTree>.
methods.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.

parameters.name: data.series

methods.description: Updates category labels along the chart axis without altering series data values. Updates both chart XML string cache and Excel worksheet row/column headers.

methods.edgeCases: Ensures synchronization between drawingML series and embedded Excel worksheet to avoid Office Repair prompts. Gracefully handles missing categories.

methods.name: updateChartTitle
methods.description: Updates the title text displayed on a chart while preserving existing title typography, rotation, and font styling.

methods.name: getCharts
methods.description: Discovers and returns descriptors for all chart elements embedded on targeted slides.

methods.edgeCases: Ensures synchronization between drawingML series and embedded Excel worksheet to avoid Office Repair prompts. Gracefully handles missing categories.

methods.name: getChartLabelPositions

returns.description: Array of spatial coordinates for each series point.

methods.name: addTextNearChartLabel

methods.description: Updates spatial coordinates, fills, borders, or visibility of an existing shape by shape ID or shape name.

parameters.name: shapeId

parameters.name: options

methods.name: updateShapeText

parameters.name: options

methods.name: getShapes
methods.description: Returns all shapes on the active slide with IDs, names, preset geometries, and bounding box coordinates.
methods.openXmlImpact: Scans <p:spTree> children.
methods.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.

methods.description: Validates DrawingML schema compliance for a given shape.
methods.openXmlImpact: Audits <p:sp> XML node.
methods.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.
methods.exampleCode:
const check = ppt.useSlide(1).validateShape('hero_box');
if (!check.valid) console.warn(check.errors);

methods.name: getBounds
methods.description: Calculates the pixel bounding box (x, y, width, height) of an element on the currently active slide.
methods.openXmlImpact: Queries a:off (offset) and a:ext (extent) coordinates and converts EMUs to integer pixels.
methods.edgeCases: Returns null if element identifier is not found on targeted slide.

returns.type: { x: number, y: number, width: number, height: number }

methods.name: setBounds
methods.description: Updates position and dimensions of an element using integer pixels or string units (e.g. "2in", "100px", "5cm").
methods.openXmlImpact: Translates units into English Metric Units (EMU) and mutates a:off / a:ext XML nodes.
methods.edgeCases: Safely handles partial coordinate overrides (e.g. updating only width without affecting position).
methods.exampleCode: ppt.setBounds('HeaderBox', { width: '8in', height: '1.5in' });

methods.name: addImage
methods.description: Embeds a new image (PNG, JPEG, GIF, SVG, WebP) onto the active slide. Copies image binary data to ppt/media/, creates a relationship link in slide{N}.xml.rels, and synthesizes a compliant <p:pic> DrawingML picture element.
methods.openXmlImpact: Writes binary file to ppt/media/image{N}.ext, registers relationship in slide{N}.xml.rels, and inserts <p:pic> with <a:blip r:embed="rId..."/>.
methods.edgeCases: Validates image format (PNG, JPEG, WebP, SVG). Recalculates natural dimensions while respecting bounding constraints.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: File path string or Buffer containing image binary bytes.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Position coordinates (x, y, width, height) and aspect ratio locking.

methods.name: replaceImage
methods.description: Replaces an existing image placeholder or picture element with new image binary data while perfectly preserving original bounding coordinates, dimensions, and z-ordering.
methods.openXmlImpact: Replaces binary bytes in ppt/media/ or updates r:embed target relationship.
methods.edgeCases: Validates image format (PNG, JPEG, WebP, SVG). Recalculates natural dimensions while respecting bounding constraints.

parameters.name: imageIdOrName
parameters.description: Existing image shape ID or picture name.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: New image file path or Buffer.

methods.exampleCode: await ppt.useSlide(1).replaceImage('headshot_placeholder', './photos/ceo.jpg');

methods.name: getImages
methods.description: Discovers and returns descriptors for all images embedded on the active slide, including target media file paths and spatial bounds.
methods.openXmlImpact: Inspects <p:pic> elements and resolves relationship IDs in slide{N}.xml.rels.
methods.edgeCases: Validates image format (PNG, JPEG, WebP, SVG). Recalculates natural dimensions while respecting bounding constraints.
methods.exampleCode:
const images = ppt.useSlide(1).getImages();
console.log('Images on slide 1:', images);

methods.name: bringToFront
methods.description: Moves an object (shape, image, table, chart, group) to the very top of the visual stacking order on the active slide, ensuring it renders above all other elements.
methods.openXmlImpact: Repositions the element XML node to the end of child elements in <p:spTree>.
methods.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.
methods.exampleCode: ppt.useSlide(1).bringToFront('active_badge');

methods.name: sendToBack
methods.description: Moves an object to the bottom of the visual stacking order, behind all other shapes and content on the active slide.
methods.openXmlImpact: Repositions element XML node to the beginning of child elements in <p:spTree>.
methods.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.
methods.exampleCode: ppt.useSlide(1).sendToBack('background_card');

methods.name: bringForward
methods.description: Increments the visual layer of an object by one step in the stacking hierarchy.
methods.openXmlImpact: Swaps element node with its immediate next sibling in <p:spTree>.
methods.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.
methods.exampleCode: ppt.useSlide(1).bringForward('icon_overlay');

methods.name: sendBackward
methods.description: Decrements the visual layer of an object by one step in the stacking hierarchy.
methods.openXmlImpact: Swaps element node with its immediate previous sibling in <p:spTree>.
methods.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.
methods.exampleCode: ppt.useSlide(1).sendBackward('shadow_shape');

methods.name: setZIndex
methods.description: Moves an object to an explicit 0-based position in the visual stack array.
methods.openXmlImpact: Slices and splices object node within <p:spTree> child nodes array.
methods.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.
methods.exampleCode: ppt.useSlide(1).setZIndex('watermark', 0);

methods.name: reorderObjects
methods.description: Re-orders all objects on the active slide according to an explicit back-to-front array of IDs.
methods.openXmlImpact: Re-sorts child nodes of <p:spTree> matching the order of orderedIds.
methods.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.

parameters.name: orderedIds
parameters.description: Array of object IDs ordered from bottom-most to top-most.

methods.exampleCode: ppt.useSlide(1).reorderObjects(['bg', 'chart1', 'overlay', 'title']);

methods.name: swapObjects
methods.description: Swaps the visual layers of two specified objects.
methods.openXmlImpact: Exchanges position indices of two nodes within <p:spTree>.
methods.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.
methods.exampleCode: ppt.useSlide(1).swapObjects('shapeA', 'shapeB');

methods.name: getObjectOrder
methods.description: Returns the current back-to-front visual order of object IDs on the active slide.
methods.openXmlImpact: Maps child node IDs in <p:spTree>.
methods.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.

returns.description: Array of object IDs in layer order.

methods.exampleCode:
const order = ppt.useSlide(1).getObjectOrder();
console.log('Stacking order:', order);

methods.name: normalizeZOrder
methods.description: Normalizes and cleans shape IDs and child node ordering to prevent Office repair warnings after heavy additions and deletions.
methods.openXmlImpact: Recompacts shape IDs and structural ordering in <p:spTree>.
methods.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.
methods.exampleCode: ppt.useSlide(1).normalizeZOrder();

methods.name: stepForward
methods.description: Moves an element one step forward in the visual stacking order (Z-index) within the slide shape tree.
methods.openXmlImpact: Permutes the child nodes inside p:spTree forward by one position.
methods.edgeCases: No-op if element is already at the topmost position.
methods.exampleCode: ppt.useSlide(1).stepForward('WatermarkShape');

methods.name: stepBackward
methods.description: Moves an element one step backward in the visual stacking order (Z-index) within the slide shape tree.
methods.openXmlImpact: Permutes the child nodes inside p:spTree backward by one position.
methods.edgeCases: No-op if element is already at the bottommost layer.
methods.exampleCode: ppt.useSlide(1).stepBackward('OverlayBox');

methods.name: addHyperlink
methods.description: Attaches an external web URL hyperlink to a text run or shape. Creates an external relationship in slide{N}.xml.rels and registers the click action.
methods.openXmlImpact: Adds <a:hlinkClick r:id="rId..."/> under <a:rPr> and registers relationship in slide{N}.xml.rels with TargetMode="External".
methods.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.

parameters.name: options.text
parameters.description: Specific text substring to attach link to.

methods.name: addSlideLink
methods.description: Creates an internal navigation jump link that transitions the slideshow presentation directly to another specified slide index when clicked.
methods.openXmlImpact: Appends <a:hlinkClick action="ppaction://hlinksldjump" r:id="rId..."/> linked to target slide relationship.
methods.edgeCases: Throws error if 1-based slide index is out of bounds [1, slideCount]. Automatically resolves layout and relationship mappings.

parameters.name: options.targetSlide
parameters.description: 1-based target slide index to navigate to.

methods.name: addImageLink
methods.description: Attaches an external web hyperlink action to an image or picture element on the active slide.
methods.openXmlImpact: Attaches <a:hlinkClick r:id="..."/> under <p:cNvPr> inside <p:pic>.
methods.edgeCases: Validates image format (PNG, JPEG, WebP, SVG). Recalculates natural dimensions while respecting bounding constraints.

parameters.name: imageId
parameters.description: Image shape ID or picture name.

methods.exampleCode: ppt.useSlide(1).addImageLink('logo_img', 'https://github.com/jsuyog2/node-pptx-templater');

methods.name: addShapeLink
methods.description: Attaches an external web click action to an entire vector shape.
methods.openXmlImpact: Mutates <p:cNvPr> in <p:nvSpPr> and links external URL relationship.
methods.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.
methods.exampleCode: ppt.useSlide(1).addShapeLink('cta_button', 'https://company.com/signup');

methods.name: addTextNavigationLink
methods.description: Creates an internal slide jump link on a specific text run inside a shape.
methods.openXmlImpact: Adds ppaction://hlinksldjump to targeted <a:rPr>.
methods.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.
methods.exampleCode: ppt.useSlide(2).addTextNavigationLink('agenda_box', 5, { text: 'Financials' });

methods.name: addShapeNavigationLink
methods.description: Makes an entire vector shape trigger navigation to another slide when clicked.
methods.openXmlImpact: Applies internal jump click action to shape <p:cNvPr>.
methods.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.
methods.exampleCode: ppt.useSlide(1).addShapeNavigationLink('next_button', 2);

methods.name: getHyperlinks
methods.description: Extracts and lists all internal and external hyperlinks defined on the specified slide.
methods.openXmlImpact: Scans slide{N}.xml.rels and matches <a:hlinkClick> tags.
methods.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.
methods.exampleCode:
const links = ppt.useSlide(1).getHyperlinks();
console.log('Slide 1 links:', links);

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs a comprehensive integrity check of the entire PowerPoint package. Verifies PresentationML schemas, checks all XML tags for balanced closures, audits DrawingML tree structures, and ensures no dangling references exist.
methods.openXmlImpact: Audits [Content_Types].xml, _rels/.rels, ppt/presentation.xml, all slides, layouts, masters, and charts.
methods.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.

returns.description: Validation outcome with list of any structural errors.

methods.name: validatePresentation
methods.description: Audits presentation-level structures: verifies slide ordering, checks layout linkages, and ensures master slide relationship consistency.
methods.openXmlImpact: Validates ppt/presentation.xml and ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels.
methods.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.
methods.exampleCode: const check = await ppt.validatePresentation();

methods.name: validateTable
methods.description: Validates a table's DrawingML grid structures, ensuring cell counts match grid columns and merge coordinates do not overlap or exceed table boundaries.
methods.openXmlImpact: Audits <a:tblGrid> and <a:tr> row/cell consistency.
methods.edgeCases: Validates row/column indices and handles merged cell boundaries without XML element interleaving.
methods.exampleCode: const res = await ppt.useSlide(1).validateTable('projectTable');

methods.name: validateRelationships
methods.description: Scans all .rels files across the presentation to ensure every relationship targets an existing package part and no unreferenced orphaned assets exist.
methods.openXmlImpact: Audits all _rels/*.rels files against package file entries.
methods.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.

returns.description: Audit result with orphaned and missing target lists.

methods.exampleCode:
const relsAudit = await ppt.validateRelationships();
console.log('Orphaned parts:', relsAudit.orphaned);

methods.name: repair
methods.description: Automatically analyzes and repairs common PowerPoint corruption triggers: fixes orphaned relationship IDs, resolves unclosed XML run tags, regenerates missing Content-Type entries, and normalizes table structures.
methods.openXmlImpact: Corrects [Content_Types].xml, trims broken .rels links, and repairs corrupted DrawingML trees.
methods.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.

methods.name: inspectXML
methods.description: Returns the formatted, syntax-indented XML content of any internal part in the presentation package (e.g. ppt/slides/slide1.xml).
methods.openXmlImpact: Reads and pretty-prints raw XML part string.
methods.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.

parameters.name: xmlPath
parameters.description: Relative part path inside PPTX package.

methods.exampleCode:
const slideXml = await ppt.inspectXML('ppt/slides/slide1.xml');
console.log(slideXml.substring(0, 500));

methods.name: inspectSlide
methods.description: Returns the formatted, indented XML string of a specific slide.
methods.openXmlImpact: Retrieves ppt/slides/slide{N}.xml.
methods.edgeCases: Throws error if 1-based slide index is out of bounds [1, slideCount]. Automatically resolves layout and relationship mappings.
methods.exampleCode: const xml = await ppt.inspectSlide(1);

methods.name: inspectChart
methods.description: Returns the formatted XML content of a specific chart part.
methods.openXmlImpact: Retrieves ppt/charts/chart{N}.xml.
methods.edgeCases: Ensures synchronization between drawingML series and embedded Excel worksheet to avoid Office Repair prompts. Gracefully handles missing categories.
methods.exampleCode: const chartXml = await ppt.inspectChart('chart1');

methods.name: debugRelationships
methods.description: Dumps all relationship entries linked to a specific slide, listing relationship IDs, schemas, and target files.
methods.openXmlImpact: Parses ppt/slides/_rels/slide{N}.xml.rels.
methods.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.
methods.exampleCode:
const rels = await ppt.debugRelationships(1);
console.table(rels);

methods.name: enablePerformanceProfile
methods.description: Activates microsecond performance telemetry profiling for all subsequent XML parsing, AST manipulations, and zip serialization.
methods.openXmlImpact: Hooks high-resolution timers around XML mutations and package compilation.
methods.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.

methods.name: getPerformanceMetrics
methods.description: Returns high-resolution timing metrics for operations performed on the presentation.
methods.openXmlImpact: Returns telemetry data map.
methods.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.

returns.description: Metrics summary object with durations in milliseconds.

methods.exampleCode: const metrics = ppt.getPerformanceMetrics();

methods.name: enableDebug
methods.description: Sets global and instance logger verbosity to debug level, printing detailed OpenXML transformation traces to stdout.
methods.openXmlImpact: Enables debug logging for all internal managers.
methods.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.
methods.exampleCode: ppt.enableDebug();
